row.title: A new top-level directory needs a repo-shape area in the same change
row.body: PR 2764 failed REPO-SHAPE-1 because .claude was claimed by no area, and the write-back must cite the session. kernel9 does not own that check; reposhape --check and writeback check run before pushing.

title: A new top-level directory needs a repo-shape area in the same change
